MuJoCo 3.11.0 WebAssembly bindings (Apache License 2.0, Google DeepMind), from the
npm package @mujoco/mujoco@3.11.0, single-threaded build: mujoco.js unmodified;
mujoco.wasm stored gzip-compressed as mujoco.wasm.gz (demo/js/lib/mujoco.js
decompresses it and passes it to the module factory as wasmBinary).
The version must match the physics model (.mjb files are version-locked).
https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/tree/main/wasm
